hints.en: For the reverse order, `b.cmp(&a) as c_int`.

tests.code: let mut v = [3, -1, 2]; sort_descending(&mut v); assert_eq!(v, [3, 2, -1]);
let mut v: [i32; 0] = []; sort_descending(&mut v); assert!(v.is_empty());
let mut v = vec![1; 3]; v.push(9); sort_descending(&mut v); assert_eq!(v, [9, 1, 1, 1]);
